data.input: Write commands consume a UTF-8 JSON envelope from --input -. validate consumes a bare object. service start optionally consumes a bare pending_stops object; service verify-takeover requires --candidate <absolute-executable>.
data.instance_binding: --expected-instance-id <id> fences resident business/query commands and disables implicit service startup.
data.run_evidence: artifacts discover|list --run-id R; artifacts collect --run-id R --input -; artifacts read --run-id R --artifact-id A; workspace-git --run-id R. Producer writes .steerrunner/artifacts/<relative_path> in original workspace. Max file 1 MiB. Read is base64; schema/limits in capabilities.run_evidence.
